results.question: 今年累计销售额是多少，累计走势如何

results.question: 最近7天滚动平均销售额是多少

results.question: 这个月和上个月的销售额、订单量、客单价对比
results.sql: SELECT month, total_sales, order_count, aov, ROUND((total_sales - LAG(total_sales) OVER (ORDER BY month)) / NULLIF(LAG(total_sales) OVER (ORDER BY month),0), 4) AS sales_mom, ROUND((order_count - LAG(order_count) OVER (ORDER BY month)) / NULLIF(LAG(order_count) OVER (ORDER BY month),0), 4) AS orders_mom, ROUND((aov - LAG(aov) OVER (ORDER BY month)) / NULLIF(LAG(aov) OVER (ORDER BY month),0), 4) AS aov_mom FROM (SELECT DATE_FORMAT(order_time,'%Y-%m') AS month, ROUND(SUM(total_amount),2) AS total_sales, COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS order_count, ROUND(SUM(total_amount)/COUNT(DISTINCT order_id),2) AS aov FROM orders WHERE order_time >= '2026-11-01' AND order_time < '2027-01-01' GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(order_time,'%Y-%m')) t ORDER BY month LIMIT 1000
